recipeContent.name: Gluten Free Orange Syrup Almond Cake
recipeIngredient: 100 g softened salted butter (or coconut oil)
1 small orange, sliced into paper-thin rounds (for candied topping)
recipeInstructions: Preheat Oven & Prep Tin:Preheat your oven to 300°F (convection / fan-forced) or 325°F (conventional bake). Grease and line an 8-inch (20 cm) springform cake pan with parchment paper.

In a small bowl, place the1.75oz caster sugar (or granulated sugar) and the finely grated zest of 2 oranges. Rub them vigorously together with your fingertips for 1 to 2 minutes until the sugar looks moist, bright orange, and deeply fragrant. Set aside.

Ensure the Thermomix mixing bowl and butterfly whisk are completely clean and grease-free. Insert Butterfly Whisk. 4 eggs (approx. 220 g), separated - just the egg whites and 1 pinch cream of tartar . Whip 3 min/speed 3.5. without the measuring cup. Transfer whipped egg whites into a large bowl and set aside. Remove Butterfly Whisk. (No need to wash the bowl).

Place the orange-infused sugar, 4 eggs (approx. 220 g), separated - just the20 sec/speed 4 yolks, 6oz blanched almond meal, 1 tsp gluten-free baking powder, 3.5oz cream cheese 20 sec/speed 4, 1 tsp vanilla bean paste into the mixing bowl.
Scrape down sides of the bowl with the spatula
Add approximately one-third of the whipped egg whites into the mixing bowl.
Pour the batter out into the large bowl containing the remaining whipped egg whites and gently fold together by hand using a silicone spatula until no white streaks remain.

Spoon batter into the prepared 8-inch springform pan and gently smooth the top. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 300°F (or 325°F conventional) until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Leave in the pan while preparing the syrup.

While the cake bakes, make the syrup on the stovetop by combining ¼ cup (1.75 oz) sugar, 2 tbsp (1 oz) fresh orange juice, 1 tsp lemon juice, 1 small cinnamon stick, and 3 lightly crushed green cardamom pods in a small skillet over medium-low heat until the sugar dissolves, then lay 1 small orange (sliced paper-thin into wheels) in a single layer and simmer gently for 6 to 8 minutes (flipping once halfway) until tender and translucent. Remove from heat, lift out the candied orange slices with tongs to arrange decoratively across the warm cake in the tin, discard the cinnamon stick and cardamom pods, spoon the warm syrup evenly all over the cake, and let it cool completely in the tin to fully absorb before releasing the springform ring and slicing.
